Utility fund user fees fall under Utility Charges per the 2026-10-28 rule. The matching detail lines (p16-17) use Utility Charges, so the same revenue is categorized inconsistently. Late fees 7,866 (receipts[25]) and Hookups 25,506 (receipts[26]) have the same issue. user_rules.py only recategorizes lines that carry a fund name, so these receipts will not be fixed automatically.
Rent belongs in its own Rentals category (amount is 0).

The category is reimbursements/refunds, but detail_category is other charges for services. Either 'reimbursements/refunds' (matching the label) or charges (rural fire contract) is defensible, but the two fields disagree.
